title: VirtuusStore adapter for the local GraphQL proxy
description:
Implement Store methods on virtuus.Database inside the FastAPI proxy. Embed Virtuus in-process. One worker. No Virtuus HTTP daemon. GraphQL contract unchanged.

Behavior is specified by plx-f04111 and the DataParade host-process story DATAP-e1d873.

Virtuus product changes are not expected; if a gap appears, file it on the Virtuus board and link here.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Wave 2 started: Coding Agent on feature/plx-f04111-virtuus-store from origin/develop. VirtuusStore adapter; no Virtuus HTTP daemon.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text:
Direct review accepted. Implementation is on `feature/plx-f04111-virtuus-store` (commit `7144f3ae5`), PR against `develop` (not `main`).

Independent validation in `services/private-graphql-proxy`:
- `PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m behave features/virtuus_local_storage.feature` — 3 scenarios, 12 steps passed
- `PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m pytest tests/ -q --ignore=tests/test_smoke_proxy.py --ignore=tests/test_scoring_integration.py` — 65 passed

Executable spec vs original story text:
- Item create/get + disk JSON, no database URL, `/readyz` 200
- Restart survival for Items (in-process store rebind on the same data directory)
- Composite Identifier create/get + disk JSON (replaced the duplicate Item contract scenario)

Residual: `list_private` is a full table scan; ScoreResult restart is the same single-PK path as Item and is not a separate scenario. Default store is still Postgres. Do not close until the `develop` PR lands.
